comment: CPU ↔ Vello budgets for corpus/generated/parity-diff.sh: the worst page's mean ΔE2000 between the two rasterizers at 144 dpi. Measured on Metal (Apple M-series) 2026-10-14; sized at the measurement + ~20 %. Never loosen one to make a run pass: fix the lane, then tighten (ADR 146). A fixture with no entry gets the default.

fixtures.name: transparency-targets
fixtures.rationale: Page 4, cases 43-48: knockout groups and non-isolated groups at 50 % with Multiply members. A Vello layer is always isolated and cannot read its initial backdrop, so both draw as isolated groups (ADR 146, known gap).

fixtures.name: text-wrap
fixtures.rationale: Dense small text: glyph-edge antialiasing differs between the lanes (analytic coverage vs area coverage), balanced in sign, p99 ~45 levels, summed over every edge pixel. Same glyph paths, same positions.

fixtures.name: column-rules
fixtures.rationale: Dense small text: nine frames of 8 pt on 10 pt, glyph-edge antialiasing (see text-wrap). The rules themselves carry 1.8 % of the page's difference (pixel columns at each rule, Metal 0.373). Measured on lavapipe (CI, 2026-10-15); sized at worst x 1.20.

fixtures.name: footnote-split
fixtures.rationale: Dense small text: a page of 10 pt body and 8 pt notes (ADR 161), glyph-edge antialiasing (see column-rules). Measured on lavapipe (CI, 2026-10-15); sized at worst x 1.20.

fixtures.name: footnote-nosplit
fixtures.rationale: Dense small text: a page of 10 pt body and 8 pt notes (ADR 161), glyph-edge antialiasing (see column-rules). Measured on lavapipe (CI, 2026-10-15); sized at worst x 1.20.

fixtures.name: text-wrap-sides
fixtures.rationale: Dense small text: glyph-edge antialiasing (see text-wrap). Measured on lavapipe (CI, 2026-10-14), worst page 14; sized at worst x 1.20.
